name: TN-02
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strong Republican district with a -17 point partisan lean
Incumbent Tim Burchett running with a large fundraising advantage
Prediction markets price Democratic chances at only about 4%
Challenger Michaela Barnett has modest resources and no outside support
model.rationale: The fundamentals point firmly to Burchett: a heavily Republican district, incumbency, and a fundraising edge of roughly six-to-one, with markets giving Barnett about a 4% chance. No polls or expert ratings suggest any reason to move materially from the fundamentals-based margin.
model.watch: A major scandal or unexpected national wave toward Democrats could tighten the race, but no current evidence points that way.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Tim Burchett seeks another term in this East Tennessee district, which leans Republican by about 17 points. He enters the race as a heavy favorite, backed by roughly $2.4 million raised and nearly $1 million on hand. Democrat Michaela Barnett has raised about $400,000, a respectable sum for a challenger but far short of the incumbent, and no outside groups are active on either side.

No public polls cover the race, and no expert raters have flagged it as competitive. Prediction markets give Barnett only about a 4% chance of winning. With a strong partisan lean, an entrenched incumbent, and a large financial gap, the race is rated Safe Republican, with Barnett needing an extraordinary shift to make it close.
